### Gene module score and checkpoint score of all cloned TCRs in spleen
```{r include=TRUE, echo=TRUE, results='hold', collapse=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.height=30, fig.width=12}
meta <- read.xlsx('Lm-TCR4.57-clonotypes-paired in rna.xlsx') %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(tissue = str_extract(Tissue_time, "(.*)-", group = 1)) %>% 
  group_by(CDRa_CDRb, timepoint, tissue, barcode) %>% 
  distinct(CDRa_CDRb, timepoint, tissue, barcode, .keep_all = TRUE) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  dplyr::filter(!str_detect(CDRa_CDRb, "_")) %>% 
  # dplyr::filter(tissue == "Spleen") %>%
  # dplyr::filter(timepoint == "d8") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(group = case_match(timepoint, c("d3") ~ "Priming", c("R5", "Y5") ~ "Recall", .default = "Primary")) %>% 
  group_by(CDRa_CDRb, group) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(n = n()) %>% 
  group_by(group) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(total_n = n()) %>% 
  ungroup()

df_tcr <- read_tsv('TCR_cloned_CDR.tsv') %>% 
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(group)) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate_at(vars('id'), as.character) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate_at(vars('id'), ~factor(.x, levels = level_TCR)) %>% 
  arrange(id) %>% 
  column_to_rownames('id') %>% 
  # dplyr::filter(group == "Primary") %>% 
  dplyr::filter(CDRa_CDRb %in% meta$CDRa_CDRb)

tibble_tcr <- df_tcr %>% rownames_to_column('id')


dft <- seu@meta.data %>% as_tibble() %>% 
  dplyr::select(timepoint, tissue, cell_module, chain1, chain2, cellnames) 
d1 <- dft %>% dplyr::select(timepoint, tissue, cell_module, chain1, cellnames) %>% rename_with(~c("timepoint", "tissue", "cell_module", "chain", "cellnames"))
d2 <- dft %>% dplyr::select(timepoint, tissue, cell_module, chain2, cellnames) %>% rename_with(~c("timepoint", "tissue", "cell_module", "chain", "cellnames"))
dft <- bind_rows(d1, d2) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(tissue == "Spleen") %>%  ### filter sp
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(chain)) %>% 
  group_by(timepoint, chain) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(count_timepoint = n())

dft_d8 <- dft %>% 
  # dplyr::filter(timepoint == "d8") %>% 
  dplyr::filter(chain %in% df_tcr$CDRa_CDRb) %>% 
  inner_join(tibble_tcr, by = join_by("chain" == "CDRa_CDRb")) %>% 
  group_by(chain) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(EMTratio = sum(cell_module %in% c("Effector-memory_transition_1", "Effector-memory_transition_2", "Effector-memory_transition_3")) / n()) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(EFFratio = 1 - EMTratio) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(MEratio = sum(cell_module %in% c("Effector-memory_transition_1", "Effector-memory_transition_2", "Effector-memory_transition_3")) / sum(cell_module %in% c("Effector_1", "Effector_2"))) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(group = case_when(sum(cell_module %in% c("Effector_1", "Effector_2"))/n() > 0.7 ~ "Eff biased",
                                  sum(cell_module %in% c("Effector-memory_transition_1", "Effector-memory_transition_2", "Effector-memory_transition_3"))/n() > 0.7 ~ "EMT biased",
                                  .default = "no bias")) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(has_memory = case_when(sum(cell_module %in% c("Memory_1", "Memory_2", "Memory_3")) > 0 ~ "Yes",
                                       .default = "No"))
dft_d8$group <- factor(dft_d8$group, levels = c("Eff biased", "no bias", "EMT biased")) 
dft_d8 <- dft_d8 %>% arrange(MEratio)
dft_d8$chain <- factor(dft_d8$chain, levels = unique(dft_d8$chain))
dft_d8$id <- factor(dft_d8$id, levels = unique(dft_d8$id))

df_gm <- module_score_cd8[dft_d8$cellnames,] %>% 
  as_tibble() 


dft_d8 <- dft_d8 %>%
  bind_cols(df_gm)



df_time_corrected_sp_pri <- readRDS(paste0(RDSdir, "chromatin_checkpoint_", "Spleen.trajectory", "_k_", k, ".rds"))
df_time_corrected_sp_pri <- df_time_corrected_sp_pri %>% 
  dplyr::filter(cellnames %in% dft_d8$cellnames) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(diff_raw = -diff,
                diff_spline = -diff_pred,
                dt_raw_cp3 = new_time - 55.912739,
                dt_spline_cp3 = old_time + diff_pred - 55.912739,
                old_time_to_cp1 = old_time - 2.520776,
                old_time_to_cp2 = old_time - 27.545472,
                old_time_to_cp3 = old_time - 55.912739,
                old_time_to_cp4 = old_time - 97.637571) 
dft_d8_sp_pri <- dft_d8 %>% dplyr::filter(phase != "Recall")
data_time_sp_pri <- df_time_corrected_sp_pri %>% inner_join(dft_d8_sp_pri, by = "cellnames") %>% 
  dplyr::mutate_at(vars(bond), ~factor(.x, levels = c("catch", "slip"))) 

df_time_corrected_sp_re <- readRDS(paste0(RDSdir, "chromatin_checkpoint_", "Spleen.trajectory_re", "_k_", k, ".rds"))
df_time_corrected_sp_re <- df_time_corrected_sp_re %>% 
  dplyr::filter(cellnames %in% dft_d8$cellnames) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(diff_raw = -diff,
                diff_spline = -diff_pred,
                dt_raw_cp3 = new_time - 51.272982,
                dt_spline_cp3 = old_time + diff_pred - 51.272982,
                old_time_to_cp1 = old_time - 1.940917,
                old_time_to_cp2 = old_time - 8.085136,
                old_time_to_cp3 = old_time - 51.272982,
                old_time_to_cp4 = old_time - 98.712833)  

dft_d8_sp_re <- dft_d8 %>% dplyr::filter(phase == "Recall")
data_time_sp_re <- df_time_corrected_sp_re %>% inner_join(dft_d8_sp_re, by = "cellnames") %>% 
  dplyr::mutate_at(vars(bond), ~factor(.x, levels = c("catch", "slip"))) 


data_time <- bind_rows(data_time_sp_pri, data_time_sp_re)


data_56_sort <- data_time %>% 
  dplyr::mutate_at(vars(bond), ~factor(.x, levels = c("catch", "slip"))) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate_at(vars(phase), ~factor(.x, levels = c("Priming", "Primary", "Recall"))) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(type = paste0(phase, "_", bond)) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate_at(vars(type), ~factor(.x, levels = c("Priming_catch", "Priming_slip", "Primary_catch", "Primary_slip", "Recall_catch", "Recall_slip"))) %>% 
  group_by(id) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(avg_newtime = mean(new_time, na.rm = TRUE)) %>% 
  arrange(type, avg_newtime) 
tcr_order <- as.character(unique(data_56_sort$id))
data_56_sort <- data_56_sort %>% dplyr::mutate_at(vars(id), ~factor(.x, levels = tcr_order))
    
plist <- list()
for (metric in c("Cytotoxicity", "Chemokine/Chemokine receptor", "Adhesion")) {
  p <- ggplot(data_56_sort, aes(x = id, y = !!sym(metric), fill = type)) +
    theme_classic() +
    # geom_jitter(size = 1, alpha = 1, width = 0.2) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.8, color = "black", show.legend = TRUE, outlier.size = 0.1) +
    # ylim(-25, 25) +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
          axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10, color = "black", angle = 45, hjust = 1),
          axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10, color = "black"),
          axis.title.x = element_text(size = 13),
          axis.title.y = element_text(size = 13)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = color_ttype)
  plist[[metric]] <- p
}

for (metric in c("old_time_to_cp1", "old_time_to_cp2", "old_time_to_cp3", "old_time_to_cp4")) {
  p <- ggplot(data_56_sort, aes(x = id, y = !!sym(metric), fill = type)) +
    theme_classic() +
    # geom_jitter(size = 1, alpha = 1, width = 0.2) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.8, color = "black", show.legend = TRUE, outlier.size = 0.1) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 2, color = 'grey') +
    ylim(-100, 100) +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
          axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10, color = "black", angle = 45, hjust = 1),
          axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10, color = "black"),
          axis.title.x = element_text(size = 13),
          axis.title.y = element_text(size = 13)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = color_ttype)
  plist[[metric]] <- p
}
wrap_plots(plist, ncol = 1)
    
```
